4.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_A1_000_3
4.description: What is that overfed opo-opo doing here?

6.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_110
6.description: At the turning of the year, a delegation of our people set sail for these shores to herald the coming of Heavensturn, and to forge new bonds of friendship between Eorzea and the Far East. It is my small role─yet my great honor─to acquaint the people of this realm with our customs.

7.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_111
7.description: Presently, I am assisting the saru bugyo with some <hex:021A020203>unorthodox<hex:021A020103> festivity preparations, but I am afraid the situation has grown beyond our control...

8.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_112
8.description: Presently, I am assisting the saru bugyo with overseeing the ongoing festivities. Thanks in no small part to your courageous efforts in the face of cyclopean difficulties, our plans for Jiromaru to win over the hearts of the Eorzean people are now well underway!

9.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_113
9.description: Despite a turbulent beginning to events, it seems this year shall belong to the monkey after all! We will be preparing rice cakes for the duration of the festival, and your continued assistance with retrieving the advent mochi would be most appreciated!

10.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_120
10.description: You are not familiar with the festival? It holds different meaning for different people, but I shall endeavor to explain its customs nonetheless...

11.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_121
11.description: In the Far East, the changing of the year is marked by the appointment of an animal totem, whilst in Eorzea, it is the captaincy of the heavens that changes hands. A deity is chosen from the ranks of the Twelve to guide the realm in the year to come.

12.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_122
12.description: This Heavensturn sees the monkey take its place in Far Eastern hearts, while Eorzea is to be ruled over by Thaliak, ruler of rivers and wisdom and god of knowledge. Such a fascinating pairing, do you not agree?

13.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_130
13.description: Within Eorzea, it would seem that the monkey is held in low esteem─an unwelcome pest, if you will. In the Far East, however, such creatures are thought to be living symbols of prosperity and good fortune.

14.name: TEXT_FESNYR2016_00314_HOSAKANN_000_131
14.description: When the season of Heavensturn comes upon us, it is tradition for our festival entertainers to recruit monkeys into their performances. The animals' playful antics are believed to serve as a beacon for harmonious and positive energies!
